newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan China Development falls at midday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan China Development falls at midday.

text.p: Taiwan's China Development Corp fell sharply at mid-session on Tuesday, suffering heavily from the market's widespread profit-taking as a result of the company's recent gains, brokers said.
With 75 minutes left, China Development had lost T$3.50 to T$104 in the session's heaviest trade volume at 39 million shares.
During the market's recent bull run, China Development had climbed from its 1997 low of T$58.40 to a peak of T$108.50.

But the company's sharp gains made it a chief target for profit-taking in Tuesday's session following the central bank governor's remark that Taiwan's stock market had "risen slightly too much", brokers said.
"The shares that have risen the most are the ones most susceptible to profit-taking. So it was China Development's turn to fall," said George Hou, a fund manager for Jardine Fleming.
